verdict.rationale: Docs confirm PIV support via SK Manager tool, including macOS PIV smart card logon configuration and PIV digital signature functions, indicating certificate-based login and code-signing use cases are supported on-device. However, evidence lacks specifics on Windows workstation sign-in via PIV, VPN integration with certificates, or independent/hands-on verification of these workflows. Missing for 10: Windows PIV smart-card logon documentation, VPN certificate-auth setup guides, independent validation of code-signing workflow, and confirmation that keys never leave the device across all these use cases.
